Crispin Plunge fiberglass pool

Big enjoyment in a small backyard: a durable, low-maintenance plunge pool with wrap-around seating.

Available version
Design this pool in 3D →Get a price →

About the Crispin Plunge

The Crispin is one of the smallest shells in the Barrier Reef range, at 16'6" by 10'. Think of it as a place to cool off, sit and talk rather than a place to swim laps. A wrap-around seating ledge is the main feature, so several people can sit in the water together.

Its floor stays at 3'11", so it isn't a diving or deep-water pool, but it's comfortable for standing and water exercise. At about 3,100 gallons, it also takes much less water to fill and heat than a full-size pool. It's worth a look for courtyards and small patios.

Who is the Crispin Plunge best for?

Courtyards and small patios, and anyone who wants to soak rather than swim.

How much yard does the Crispin Plunge need?

As a first estimate, allow about 25' by 18' for the Crispin Plunge, which adds a 4-foot walkway on each side. Your setbacks, easements and deck plans decide the real limit, and we confirm them on the free site visit.
